'''''Pabol Hutta''''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that linked [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]]. It was the entryway into the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'', the "Garden of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]" where the throneworlds of the various Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidics]] were to be found. The ''Pabol Hutta'' was rarely traveled by outsiders.
